description: This file defines utility functions and classes related to tensor creation and manipulation in the ATen/native namespace, including size calculations for tensor operations, argument checks, tensor filling, and a zero tensor allocator. It also declares dispatch stubs for complex and polar functions.

classes.name: ZeroTensorAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that always returns nullptr for allocations, used for zero tensors.

methods.name: get_tril_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a lower triangular (or trapezoidal) tensor segment based on row, column, and offset parameters.

methods.name: check_args
methods.description: Checks that row and col are non-negative and that layout, if provided, is torch.strided.

methods.name: check_supported_max_int_with_precision
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum value n-1 fits within the tensor's scalar type precision.

methods.name: fill_empty_deterministic_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with NaN for floating/complex types or max value for integer types when deterministic algorithms are enabled.
